nodes.label: Missed-Detection Diagnosis (test split) - Exp2
nodes.rationale: Of 1985 missed GT instances, 83.2% were seen but scored below the 0.35 operating point, 15.3% were found with different box geometry (IoU<0.5), 0.4% were class confusions, and only 1.2% were genuinely unseen. The bottleneck is the operating point and annotation geometry, not model capacity or training data volume.

nodes.label: Missed-Detection Diagnosis (val split) - Exp2
nodes.rationale: Val split mirrors test: 89.2% BELOW_CONF, 7.4% POOR_BOX, 0.9% WRONG_CLASS, 2.5% BLIND out of 1723 misses. Consistency across splits shows the diagnosis is systematic, not split noise.

nodes.label: Confidence Threshold Sweep (test) - Exp2
nodes.rationale: mAP50 is identical at every threshold because it already integrates over all confidence levels; the sweep moves the operating point, not accuracy, and no row should be reported as an accuracy gain. F1-optimal conf is 0.33 for both eye classes (+0.1 pt) but 0.25 for yawning (+2.15 pts F1, recall 67.95% -> 87.99%).

nodes.label: BELOW_CONF failure mode
nodes.rationale: Model localized and classified the object correctly but scored it under the 0.35 operating threshold. Fixable by moving the threshold, not by adding data.

nodes.label: POOR_BOX failure mode
nodes.rationale: Detection exists but predicted/GT area ratio is far from 1.0 (yawning median 0.44; eye classes ~2.0-2.2), the signature of BOOK.md D4 annotation-geometry disagreement rather than model blindness.

nodes.label: BLIND failure mode
nodes.rationale: Object genuinely never detected at any confidence - only 1.2% of test misses. The only bucket that argues for more or better training data.

nodes.label: WRONG_CLASS failure mode
nodes.rationale: Object detected but assigned the wrong class; near zero (0.4%), so the three classes are well separated in feature space.

nodes.label: closed_eye class
nodes.rationale: Strongest class in every experiment (AP@50 83.7-89.1%); the primary drowsiness signal. 86% of its misses are BELOW_CONF.

nodes.label: open_eye class
nodes.rationale: Consistently the weakest-recall class (64-71%) despite decent precision; 94% of its test misses are BELOW_CONF, so it is threshold-limited rather than data-limited.

nodes.label: yawning class
nodes.rationale: The class the YOLO26n generation fixed: AP@50 rises from ~49% on both YOLO11n baselines and the old nano baseline to 73-79%. Its misses are 26% POOR_BOX with median area ratio 0.44, indicating annotator/model disagreement on mouth box scale.
